ssg example site

A minimal static site built with python -m ssg build example dist.

This site shows off the Markdown features ssg supports: headings, emphasis, inline code, links, lists, fenced code blocks, and block quotes.

Posts

  • Welcome
  • Why a static site generator
  • Markdown the spec way
  • A fenced code delight

To rebuild the site:

python -m ssg build example dist
